photos.c: Arnold Bent clears 5ft 9in, his best in competition
photos.cap: Arnold Bent (Youth) clears his best ever in competition - 5'9 but has gone higher still in training.

photos.c: Charlie Dabbs leads Dai Davies and Mike Fuller
photos.cap: TOP LEFT:Charlie Dabbs (78) with Dai Davies (TVH/49) and Mike Fuller (Wimb/67) close behind.

photos.c: John Dear and Howard Satchell plough through the mud
photos.cap: John Dear (left) and Howard Satchell plough their way through the mud with only 1½ miles gone.

photos.c: John Mitchell qualifies for the 100y final in 9.9
photos.cap: BOTTOM LEFT: John Mitchell qualifying for the 100y final in 9.9 behind Tymms (Surrey).

photos.c: John Thresher takes over from Mel Thorpe
photos.cap: Right: John Thresher takes over from Mel Thorpe.

photos.c: Tony Fairclough sends Adrian Major away
photos.cap: LEFT: Tony Fairclough completes our fastest short stage to send Adrian Major away.

photos.c: Carl Lawton, 7th in the Lambeth 5
photos.cap: CARL LAWTON (left) was a well placed 7th in the Lambeth '5', while RAY HALL (right) produced one of his "retirement" outings to finish 24th.

photos.c: Charlie Gillett clocks 50.7 for 400m
photos.cap: Right: Charlie Gillett continues to pound the 400 metre circuit. In the Wimbledon race he clocked his fastest of the season - 50.7.

photos.c: Lionel Mann leads John Bicourt and Brian Gorman
photos.cap: Lionel Mann leads from John Bicourt and Brian Gorman soon after the start of the Club '10'.

photos.c: Dawn McNeil, Ladies Section track captain
photos.cap: Dawn McNeil, the Ladies Section Track Captain, raises a smile in spite of another punishing Sunday morning.

photos.c: Harry Churcher, 5th in the 1948 Olympic 10,000m walk
photos.cap: Harry Churcher finishes 5th in the final of the 10,000m Walk at the 1948 Olympics held in London.

photos.c: Pat O’Connor sends Lionel Mann away in the Belgrave Relay
photos.cap: Lionel Mann is sent on his way by Pat O'Connor in the Belgrave Relay

photos.c: Ernest Obeng wins the AAA indoor 60m
photos.cap: Ernest Obeng winning the AAA's 60m Indoor title from Buster Watson(Blackheath). In 3rd spot is Ex-Belgravian Jim Evans who left for Epsom but is now also with Blackheath.

photos.c: Phil Lovell sets a club pole vault record of 4.75m
photos.cap: Back Cover. Welcome to new member Phil Lovell who has already set a new Club PV record of 4.75m. Phil will be eligible to compete for us in the 3rd British League Match.

photos.c: John Regis runs a 45.36 relay split
photos.cap: An "unfit" John Regis was persuaded to run a 400m relay leg in the first B.A.L. Match at Birmingham and clocked an impressive 45.36 split - wearing his new "1 piece".

photos.c: Alison Caulker dips to win the 200m
photos.cap: (78) Alison Caulker dips to beat Gail George (63) in 200m.

photos.c: Carl Lawton on his way to winning the London to Brighton
photos.cap: Left Carl Lawton on his way to winning the London to Brighton.

photos.c: Kevin Sturman and Gary Staines sprint for the line
photos.cap: Kevin Sturman's determination shows as he and Gary Staines sprint for the line in the last Surrey C.C. League at Coulsdon.

photos.c: Haroun Korjie, 10.53 on his debut
photos.cap: Left: Haroun Korjie made his debut for the Bels at Copthall by running to 10.53 for 3rd in the 'A' 100m.

photos.c: Justin Chaston, maximum points in the steeplechase
photos.cap: Jetting over from the U.S.A. for the first three BAL matches, Justin Chaston steeplechased his way to maximum points on each occasion.

photos.c: The British Athletics League trophy
photos.cap: Above: Phil Goedluck and Haroun Korjie hold the British Athletics League Trophy with Bruce Barton, Darryl Maynard and Neil Owen for company.

photos.c: Pat Newell, first M60 in the Belgrave 10k
photos.cap: Above: Pat Newell nears the end of the Belgrave 10k on October 24th where he clocked up 38:23 for first M60.

photos.c: Snowy Brooks, World Veterans’ decathlon silver medallist
photos.cap: Above: Silver medallist in the World Veterans' Championships Decathlon in Buffalo, Snowy picked up medals galore during the BVAF Open Championships at Exeter.

photos.c: Mark Anderson chases Chris Ogle in the 1500m
photos.cap: With 300 metres to go in the 1500 it seemed that Mark Anderson (58) might just get on terms with Chris Ogle (65) but the gap remained the same to the line.

photos.c: Jennifer Culley takes the baton from Hannah Stares
photos.cap: Top left: Jennifer Culley takes the baton from Hannah Stares to run the last leg of the 4 x 400 metres and bring the Belles home to another win.

photos.c: Maureen Noel in the 10k track walk
photos.cap: Above: Maureen Noel, pictured during the 10k track walk at Battersea Park back in April by Jeremy Hemming.

photos.c: Eva Massey helps the Belles qualify
photos.cap: Eva Massey provided a huge boost to the team when she turned out at the end of the season to help the Belles qualify for the UK Women's League.

photos.c: Phil Wicks and Stephen Sharp at Brockwell Park
photos.cap: “Sweatshop” Surrey CC League Race 1 at Brockwell Park, and Phil Wicks (9) and Stephen Sharp (1) slug it out at the front of the field.

photos.c: Allen and Andy Graffin, fastest long and short stages
photos.cap: Centre right: "Belgrave's double whammy". Allen Graffin and Andy Graffin clocked the fastest long and short stages of the day.

photos.c: Mark Miles stretches the lead on stage 5
photos.cap: Bottom left: Mark Miles took the Belgrave lead to over two minutes on stage 5.
